title: Elkanah of Ramathaim-zophim
text: Now there was a man named Elkanah who was from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim.

title: Hannah Had None
text: He had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah. And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

title: Year after Year at Shiloh
text: Year after year Elkanah would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh …

title: A Double Portion
text: But to Hannah he would give a double portion, for he loved her even though the LORD had closed her womb.

title: The LORD Had Closed Her Womb
text: … for he loved her even though the LORD had closed her womb.

title: Her Rival Provoked Her
text: Because the LORD had closed Hannah’s womb, her rival would provoke her viciously to taunt her.

title: She Wept and Would Not Eat
text: Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the LORD, her rival taunted her until she wept and would not eat.

title: Why Are You Crying?
text: Hannah, why are you crying? | Why won’t you eat? Why is your heart so grieved?

title: Better than Ten Sons
text: Am I not better to you than ten sons?

title: By the Doorpost
text: Now Eli the priest was sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the temple of the LORD.

title: Prayed and Wept
text: In her bitter distress, Hannah prayed to the LORD and wept with many tears.

title: A Vow
text: And she made a vow, saying, “O LORD of Hosts, if only You will look upon the affliction of Your maidservant and remember me …

title: No Razor on His Head
text: … then I will dedicate him to the LORD all the days of his life, and no razor shall ever touch his head.

title: Eli Thought She Was Drunk
text: Hannah was praying in her heart, and though her lips were moving, her voice could not be heard. So Eli thought she was drunk …

title: I Poured Out My Soul
text: I have not had any wine or strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the LORD.

title: Go in Peace
text: Go in peace, | and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him.

title: Her Face Was No Longer Downcast
text: Then she went on her way, and she began to eat, and her face was no longer downcast.

title: The LORD Remembered Her
text: … and the LORD remembered her.

title: Samuel
text: She named him Samuel, saying, “Because I have asked for him from the LORD.”

title: After the Boy Is Weaned
text: After the boy is weaned, | I will take him to appear before the LORD and to stay there permanently.

title: May the LORD Confirm His Word
text: Only may the LORD confirm His word.

title: A Bull, Flour and Wine
text: Hannah took the boy with her, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour, and a skin of wine.

title: The House of the LORD at Shiloh
text: Though the boy was still young, she brought him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh.

title: They Brought the Boy to Eli
text: And when they had slaughtered the bull, they brought the boy to Eli.

title: The Woman Who Stood Here
text: I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD.

title: I Prayed for This Boy
text: I prayed for this boy, and since the LORD has granted me what I asked of Him …

title: Dedicated to the LORD
text: I now dedicate the boy to the LORD. For as long as he lives, he is dedicated to the LORD.

title: They Worshiped the LORD There
text: So they worshiped the LORD there.

title: My Heart Rejoices in the LORD
text: My heart rejoices in the LORD; my horn is exalted in the LORD.

title: No One Holy like the LORD
text: There is no one holy like the LORD. Indeed, there is no one besides You!

title: Ministering before Eli
text: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy began ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest.

title: A Little Robe
text: Each year his mother would make him a little robe and bring it to him when she went with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

title: Three Sons and Two Daughters
text: So the LORD attended to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters.

title: In Favor with the LORD and Man
text: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with man.

title: My Soul Magnifies the Lord
text: My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!

title: Peninnah's Children
text: And Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

title: Hophni and Phinehas
text: … where Eli’s two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were priests to the LORD.

title: In Bitter Distress
text: In her bitter distress, Hannah prayed to the LORD and wept with many tears.

title: Year after Year
text: Year after year Elkanah would go up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh …
